hypothesis: A high-precision classifier trained on causal safe-bomb outcomes can identify rare attack opportunities where a bomb improves eliminations, while an exact geometric and Q-rank gate preserves the anti-loop fallback everywhere else.
changed_factor: The candidate adds one frozen linear kill-success classifier and permits at most one safe BOMB override per round when the parent ranks BOMB second or third; the baseline uses broad_persistent unchanged.
controls: Same checkpoint, DQN features and weights, broad persistent loop guard, action mask, scenarios, opponents, slots, and paired evaluation seeds. The learned artifact cannot alter Q-values or non-attack actions.

dataset.selection: All safe_attack=true placed-bomb records; labels are owner-attributed kill without self-kill.

selection: Reject training if grouped OOF precision exposure fails. Among pilot-eligible rank gates, choose the largest paired kill gain, then score gain, then the narrower rank gate. Confirm once on fresh worlds; never promote automatically.

pc.note: Cumulative issue #225 debit through completed V10; shared cap is not reset.

authorization.record: 2026-09-21: primary goal is killing without losing reduced looping or learned abilities; autonomous training and selection decisions authorized through final submission preparation.
authorization.scope: Classifier training, paired evaluation, confirmation, watcher recovery, evidence export, and packaging only after every registered gate passes.
